title: Connect GadgetManager to Panel - Display Gadget Buttons
instructions: Fix run.py so that enabled gadgets (hello_world, test_gadget) actually appear as clickable buttons in the panel. The GadgetManager already loads them, but they're never added to the panel UI.

1784825973.9373271.instruction: Check the panel code and gadget discovery to understand why enabled gadgets (hello_world, test_gadget) don't show buttons

1784825977.8610802.instruction: Update the notices gadget at ~/.config/KosDWM/gadgets/notices.py to properly find KosDWM modules using the config file or environment variable

1784825982.7369719.instruction: Ensure install_kosdwm.py is in the correct location and creates proper launcher scripts with KOSDWM_HOME environment variable

1784825986.4827363.instruction: Create a diagnostic script that checks if KosDWM is properly installed and helps troubleshoot gadget issues

1784832358.3727071.instruction: Read run.py to see how Panel and GadgetManager are created, and identify where gadget buttons should be added

1784832361.2431877.instruction: Read src/gadgets/manager.py to see how to get enabled gadgets and their button representations

1784832364.5168629.instruction: Read src/panel.py to understand the panel structure and how to add new buttons for gadgets

1784832367.486975.instruction: Update run.py to get enabled gadgets from GadgetManager and add them as buttons to the panel

1784832370.2516673.instruction: Start KosDWM and verify that hello_world and test_gadget buttons appear in the panel and are clickable
